# [Virtualmin Podman module 2.0.0 released](https://forum.virtualmin.com/t/virtualmin-podman-module-2-0-0-released/138202)


[News](https://forum.virtualmin.com/c/news/5)


[pro-only](https://forum.virtualmin.com/tag/pro-only)


[Ilia](https://forum.virtualmin.com/u/Ilia)


October 22, 2026, 1:11am 1


Howdy all,


We’ve rolled out Virtualmin Podman 2.0.0 to all Virtualmin repos.


Changes since Virtualmin Podman 1.7.1:


- Add scheduled image update checks, manual updates and version selection in the UI, CLI and remote API
- Add an option to control each domain owner’s access to container apps
- Fix failed container updates to restore the original container and settings
- Fix ignored image-pull settings when creating or updating containers
- Fix unnecessary restarts and failures to find existing containers during updates
- Fix containers stopping when the root user logs out


Changes since Virtualmin Podman 1.7.0:


- Add Baserow with private PostgreSQL and Redis services
- Fix environment variable formatting in recipe instructions


---


As always, if you run into any problems, let us know in a *new* topic.
